_readme: Public data is listing/asking-rate or modeled, NOT transacted agency-placed pricing. That gap is what we collect via the quote log. Re-verify every figure before launch.

data_points.notes: Social Security and Medicare apply once you pay one household employee $3,000+ in cash wages in 2026. Verified on irs.gov 2026-11-17.

data_points.source_name: IRS Publication 926 (2026), Household Employer's Tax Guide
data_points.notes: Employer share: 6.2% Social Security + 1.45% Medicare. The employee's 7.65% is withheld from their pay. Verified on irs.gov 2026-11-17.

data_points.source_name: IRS Publication 926 (2026), Household Employer's Tax Guide
data_points.notes: Social Security stops at this wage; Medicare has no cap. Verified on irs.gov 2026-11-17.

data_points.source_name: IRS Publication 926 (2026), Household Employer's Tax Guide
data_points.notes: FUTA applies once you pay $1,000+ in cash wages in any calendar quarter. Verified on irs.gov 2026-11-17.

data_points.source_name: IRS Publication 926 (2026), Household Employer's Tax Guide
data_points.notes: 6% minus up to 5.4% credit for paying state unemployment on time. Verified on irs.gov 2026-11-17.

data_points.source_name: IRS Publication 926 (2026), Household Employer's Tax Guide
data_points.notes: FUTA applies to the first $7,000 per employee per year. Verified on irs.gov 2026-11-17.
